races.paceDynamic: Saisons d'Or will lead from the front with minimal pressure, creating a measured early gallop over this 7f trip. Hint Of The Jungle and Dolly's Delight are the only prominent runners likely to track close, but neither appears aggressive enough to seriously pressure the leader. With 9 of 12 runners preferring hold-up tactics, the field will be bunched behind a sedate pace until the straight. This tactical setup strongly favors hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as they'll get the perfect scenario of a slow pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Saisons d'Or sets uncontested fractions and the field bunches for a cavalry charge
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with plenty of pace to aim at in the final 2f. Form horses with finishing kicks dominate the placings.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Modest Early Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Hint Of The Jungle or Dolly's Delight apply some early pressure to Saisons d'Or
scenarios.body: The pace lifts slightly but still favors closers, though those tracking prominently early gain positional advantage. Late runners must be sharper to make up ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Kicks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Saisons d'Or gets uncontested lead and maintains strong gallop to home straight
scenarios.body: The veteran front-runner uses tactical advantage to steal crucial lengths, making the task harder for closers. Those with early pace find it easier to respond.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Tactical Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If no horse shows early pace and everyone waits behind Saisons d'Or
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy stop-start affair with no rhythm, suiting only the most versatile performers. Jockey skills become paramount in the scramble.

races.paceDynamic: Arlington and Stash The Cash will lead early with Nad Alshiba Snow, Marcus, and Beneficiary prominent behind them, creating a modest early gallop over this minimum trip. The two hold-up horses Man On A Mission and Invitorio lack early pace, while The Carligation and Fumbleinthejungle both carry stamina doubts after long breaks. With multiple prominent runners but no confirmed tearaway leader, this sets up as a steady-to-strong pace that will favour horses with tactical speed who can position handy and quicken - the prominent brigade holds the key tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Arlington, Stash The Cash, and Nad Alshiba Snow maintain their early positions through steady fractions
scenarios.body: The handy trio can dictate terms and kick clear in the final furlong as the hold-up pair struggle to make up ground over the minimum trip. This pace profile suits horses who race on the speed without being overstretched early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly strong with Arlington and Stash The Cash going too fast
scenarios.body: Man On A Mission and Invitorio can capitalize on their finishing kick as the prominent runners tie up in the closing stages. The 5f trip becomes more testing when the pace is injudicious.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improver from off pace
scenarios.trigger: If Beneficiary finds significant improvement from his recent second and gets the perfect trip tracking the leaders
scenarios.body: The seven-year-old can use his proven course form and Billy Garritty's tactical nous to strike late. His recent run suggests he retains ability despite moderate trainer stats.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If The Carligan runs fresh after 698 days off and avoids his usual late fade
scenarios.body: John Jenkins' charge could surprise at huge odds if ring-rusty legs hold out over this sharp 5f trip. His historical form shows some ability before the lengthy absence.

watchPoints.text: The Carligation represents huge unknown after 698 days off - either fresh and dangerous at big odds or completely unfit
Watch if Arlington goes too fast early as the likely leader, which could set up the race for Man On A Mission and Invitorio
Invitorio's price will be telling given recent 5f win and Ruth Carr's 5/31 strike-rate suggesting yard in decent form
Both Stash The Cash and Marcus return from breaks of 76+ days, monitor market confidence for either resuming runner
Beneficiary's recent second at this course suggests he retains ability despite trainer's poor recent record

This race shape strongly favours horses that can race prominently or lead, as the pace will be honest but not destructive over this minimum trip.

races.paceDynamic: Lednikov represents the sole confirmed front runner in this 10-runner handicap, giving him uncontested early control to dictate terms over the 1m4f trip. Night Bear, Artavian, and Electric Bass will track prominently but won't challenge for the lead, creating a sustainable tempo that allows the pace-setter to travel comfortably through the middle sections. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Jack Andrea, Eagles Whistle, Tupero, Arth's Gold, Spec Of Light, and Shaffron will settle towards the rear, banking on a late charge. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions without expending energy, as the sustainable gallop will make it difficult for hold-up horses to make up significant ground in the home straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lednikov Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Lednikov maintains his rhythm and the prominent trackers don't pressure him early.
scenarios.body: The lone leader travels sweetly into the straight with the held-up brigade facing an impossible task against his sustained gallop. Front running tactics prove decisive on a track that rewards those who can dictate from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Night Bear or Artavian can stalk Lednikov perfectly and time their challenge.
scenarios.body: The prominent racers get ideal positioning behind the leader and strike when Lednikov begins to tire in the final furlong. Their tactical advantage over the hold-up horses proves crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or Lednikov goes too fast early.
scenarios.body: Jack Andrea or Eagles Whistle benefit from strong early fractions and unleash devastating late runs to catch the tiring leaders. Their class tells when others have expended too much energy.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the running styles don't unfold as expected or there's interference.
scenarios.body: An unexpected pace scenario develops with prominent horses going faster than anticipated or hold-up horses finding gaps. Form horses capitalise on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Monitor if any prominent horses challenge Lednikov early, as this would completely change the race dynamic and help hold-up horses.
Watch Night Bear's jumping from the gates after 31 days off, as he needs to secure his tracking position behind Lednikov immediately.
Observe Artavian and Electric Bass for signs of ring rustiness given their lengthy absences of 181 and 130 days respectively.
Check if Jack Andrea or Eagles Whistle can secure forward positions early, as sitting too far back will make their task impossible.
Watch Lednikov's early fractions, as any sign of over-racing would bring the hold-up horses into serious contention.

This race shape strongly favours horses that can secure good early positions and avoid the scramble - prominent racers and those hold-up horses with tactical pace will benefit most.

races.paceDynamic: Pinjarra stands as the only confirmed front runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead, with Angel Of England, Queensmaite and Tommytwohoots the most likely to sit prominent positions. The lack of early speed will allow the large contingent of hold-up horses to get competitive positions without being strung out. This tactical scenario strongly favours horses that can travel handily or close with a turn of foot, rather than pure front runners who need pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If Pinjarra gets a soft lead with moderate fractions through the first half
scenarios.body: The pace will be insufficient to set up the race for closers, allowing the leader to maintain enough energy for the finish. Front runners and prominent racers will have the tactical advantage over hold-up horses who need stronger pace.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.body: An uneven gallop will create gaps and opportunities for horses with cruising speed to exploit. The race will become more tactical, suiting versatile horses who can adapt to different positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Setup

scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the 2f marker, heavily favouring horses with the highest cruising speed regardless of position. Raw ability trumps tactics in this compressed finish.
